fusions.name: Chilled Barb
fusions.desc: Looses a chilled arrow that deals 5 frost damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Waited-For Shot
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 14 frost damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Tail Regrown
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you, rising 8% for every tenth of your health already lost, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Aim
fusions.desc: During the day, you deal 12% more damage.
